title: Print each country with a for loop
description:
Use for loop to print each country in the countries list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as printed_countries(countries), returning the exact multi-line string that a for loop printing each country on its own line would write to the screen (lines joined with '\n').
hints: A for loop like `for country in countries: print(country)` writes one line per country, each ending in a newline.
'\n'.join(...) builds exactly that text - one item per line - without actually calling print().
expected_behavior: Returns the string that a for loop printing each country on its own line would produce, with lines separated by newline characters.
solution:
def printed_countries(countries):
    return '\n'.join(str(c) for c in countries)

hidden_tests.label: six countries printed one per line
empty list produces an empty string

explanation: '\n'.join() places a newline between each country name, which is exactly the text a for loop calling print(country) on each item would send to the screen.
